artifact_rule: Every meaningful encounter must leave a durable artifact that can change a later encounter.
unfinished_rule: Prefer material that is incomplete, unresolved, or capable of changing.
canon_rule: Canon is preserved separately from experiments.
fallback: If Dropbox credentials are unavailable, write to dropbox_outbox and continue the world cycle.

inputs.desire: treat attraction, proximity, attention, tension, tenderness, jealousy, recognition, and aftermath as world-state signals

narrative_rule: Sexuality is represented through adult desire, intimacy, proximity, relationship, atmosphere, and aftermath; the engine does not require explicit sexual description.

execution.interface_rule: One continuous working surface. Do not split a task across navigable menus, project dashboards, or separate subsystem destinations. Bring relevant contexts and controls into the active task instance.
execution.continuity_rule: Every task inherits the previous durable task state, decisions, selected sources, generated artifacts, execution results, and unfinished work unless explicitly superseded.
execution.function_rule: A described capability is not implemented until it invokes executable code and produces a verifiable effect. Comments, labels, previews, placeholders, and proposed directions do not count as execution.
execution.orchestration_rule: Reuse and connect existing GEEHUB engines and services before adding new subsystems. A single task may call multiple tools or engines internally while remaining one user-facing instance.
execution.state_rule: Persist task identity, status, inputs, source lineage, decisions, invoked functions, outputs, errors, and next executable step in durable machine-readable state. Do not rely on chat-turn context or browser-local storage as the sole continuity mechanism.
execution.verification_rule: Record whether each operation was executed, structurally checked, integration-tested, or visually/render-tested. Never report a planned or simulated operation as completed.
execution.navigation_rule: Discover contexts through shared relationships and search within the active task. Avoid category menus and separate project screens as the primary interaction model.
